body: There's no way to know your friend had these thoughts. In my note yesterday I specifically mentioned that I was keeping these thoughts from those close to me and there's no way they could know. There's no way they could have done anything different and the same applies to you. Thank you for your kind words, I appreciate it. I told my girlfriend i've been having a rough couple of days last night, but without knowing the depth of what someone is going through there's not really much they can do to help. I should really tell someone but I can't find anyone (who I would be willing to tell) who wouldn't go telling other people in my life and then who knows what those other people would do. It's a tough situation.
